comparisonToCleanMPFB.topology: Both are coherent closed oriented whole-body manifolds. Blenderbody has10582vertices with existingUVMap; MPFB bodygroup13380vertices/13378quads and explicit jointhelper/rigweight sources.
comparisonToCleanMPFB.limitations: RawMPFB proportions/sourceaxes differ; samefamily as rejected bakedhm08, not a pass for reused oldshape/weights. Blenderbody is unrigged with no shape keys/materials/groups, while Multires appearance data exists.
comparisonToCleanMPFB.selectionRecommendation: Prefer this cleanBlender body as the fresh sculpt/retopology foundation, retaining coherentheadneckthorax and sourcehand topology. Do not transplant old rigidbust; reshape facialidentity on continuoussurface. MPFB remains fallback/proportion/jointreference, not an automatic skin source.

observations: The source supplies ONE complete contiguous skull/neck/thorax and paired limbs; no disconnected donorbust joins exist in this source topology.

The rest hands have four separated longdigit distal graph components plus separate thumb section. AtZ.76 eachlongdigit has10crossed actualsurfaceedges; this is useful circumferential topology, not proof of MCP/PIP/DIP articulation.

Forearm/elbow sections have24–26crossed surfaceedges; knee/thigh sections20. Shoulder/axilla and hip pole neighborhoods are explicitly inventoried for authoring; allquads alone do not guarantee goodbendvolume.
No existing skin/bind/animation is inherited. One anatomical skeleton and controlledweights/correctives must be authored after adultproportion/restpose decisions.
